name: Baku City Circuit

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap circuit relation 11266687 (ways ordered by shared nodes, © OSM contributors), anticlockwise; station 0 at its "finish" node 13826310747 (the "start" node is ~110 m further, on the grid side)
sources.width: Published: 7.6 m at the narrowest point of the castle section (T8), ~9-10 m through the old town, wide boulevards (12-15 m) elsewhere
sources.elevation: Copernicus GLO-30 has no tiles for Azerbaijan (withheld from the public release), so AWS Terrain Tiles (terrarium z14, https://registry.opendata.aws/terrain-tiles/, SRTM-derived ~30-90 m) were used; 30th percentile over +-75 m then 3 passes of a ~130 m moving average to suppress buildings
sources.trim: Low downforce for the 2.2 km flat-out Neftchilar run (Baku/Jeddah/Las Vegas ~0.85-0.9)
sources.pitLimit: FIA Azerbaijan GP event notes: pit lane speed limit 80 km/h
sources.pitLoss: Typical F1 pit-stop loss ~20-21 s at Baku (F1/Pirelli strategy previews); approximate
sources.raceLaps: FIA 2026 Azerbaijan GP: 51 laps (Saturday race); not a sprint weekend

notes: 20-turn numbering assigned from curvature peaks in race order; the flat-out kinks T17-T20 on Neftchilar Avenue and T11 are approximate. Elevation from a ~30-90 m global model: the old-town climb shape is coarse.
